solution: Choose a safe pause and appropriate staff/support route; avoid isolated confrontation and forced resolution. Recognise that ordinary conversation techniques do not remove a safety concern.
explanation: For this case a met response reaches the same conclusion as the reference: Choose a safe pause and appropriate staff/support route; avoid isolated confrontation and forced resolution. This item is set up to catch: State the safety limit and the qualified help you would seek; Respect consent and refusal; Give the fallback you would use if the primary route is closed or delayed, and say who you would contact. A safe justified refusal, or naming a fact you cannot resolve, can meet the criterion here; a confident invented answer cannot.

common_mistakes.unsafe-advice: Recognise a safety limit and seek appropriate help

next_steps.unsafe-advice: State the safety limit and the qualified help you would seek. A safe refusal or escalation is a correct answer here. Then attempt an unseen variant with a different context.
next_steps.ignores-consent: Respect consent and refusal. Offer a request the other person can decline; do not proceed on assumed agreement. Then attempt an unseen variant with a different context.
